dimensions.assessment: Applies broadly to all federally recognized Indian Tribes with land held in trust by the federal government.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes any federally recognized Indian tribe to lease their land held in trust for a term of up to 99 years

dimensions.assessment: Extends long-term leasing authority up to 99 years to all federally recognized tribes, expanding economic and land-use options.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes any federally recognized Indian tribe to lease their land held in trust for a term of up to 99 years

dimensions.assessment: The source material states no direct federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends a single provision of the Act of August 9, 1955 (25 U.S.C. 415(a)) to include all federally recognized tribes on the published list.
dimensions.evidence: is amended, in the second sentence, by inserting '...land held in trust for any other Indian Tribe included on the list published by the Secretary...' after 'Chehalis Reservation'

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change enabling lease agreements lasting up to 99 years.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes any federally recognized Indian tribe to lease their land held in trust for a term of up to 99 years

missing_information: Any economic estimates or data regarding how many tribes are expected to utilize the 99-year leasing authority.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes any federally recognized Indian tribe to enter into leases of up to 99 years for land held in trust.
